name: treasurybox
description: TreasuryBox — AI treasury agent for LatAm merchants (local stablecoins)

scripts.build:ripio: RAIL_PROVIDER=ripio npm run build -w @treasurybox/rails && RAIL_PROVIDER=ripio NEXT_PUBLIC_RAIL_PROVIDER=ripio npm run build -w @treasurybox/panel && npm run verify:shake -- ripio
scripts.build:twin: RAIL_PROVIDER=twin npm run build -w @treasurybox/rails && npm run build -w @treasurybox/panel && npm run verify:shake -- twin
scripts.build:full: RAIL_PROVIDER=full npm run build -w @treasurybox/rails && npm run build -w @treasurybox/panel
